explanation: This theorem is part of the metric Hopf–Rinow theorem: a complete Riemannian manifold is a geodesic space. I searched Mathlib for `IsGeodesicSpace`, `Hopf` and `expDomain` and found none of these Riemannian notions. The only `Hopf` matches are about Hopf algebras and H-spaces. The only file under `Mathlib/Geometry` that mentions geodesics is `Group/WordMetric.lean`, which is about word metrics on groups. `IsGeodesicSpace`, the exponential-map domain and the lemmas used in the proof all come from the library itself, so Mathlib has no matching result.
